{{Quote|At least the New Republic can evacuate the next target before they show."<br />"Yes. Let's see what happens at New Holgha.|Goran Beviin and Boba Fett on Birgis|<ref name="BFPM" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[New Holgha]] three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|attempt to overthrow]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The governing [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], believing [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] to be faulty due to the Mandalorians' public alliance with the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] Yuuzhan Vong, falsely deduced that the target of the invaders was [[Pedd Four|Pedd 4]], and withdrew most of New Holgha's defenses there. Resultantly, New Holgha fell to the Yuuzhan Vong with little resistance. [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalorian leader]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] encountered a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] while assisting the Yuuzhan Vong on New Holgha, and recruited him to reliably pass on vital intelligence to the New Republic.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|And what happens when the New Republic praises its brave Mando allies for slipping intel to them? It's going to happen. And "oops" won't cut it with the Vong."<br />"Then I'll swallow my nausea, and payday with the Vong is over.|Goran Beviin and Boba Fett on Birgis|<ref name="BFPM" />}}
In [[25 ABY]], during the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|attempted conquest]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the marauding [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] [[Battle of Birgis|attacked]] the<ref name="BFPM" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Atlas" /> of [[Birgis]]. Maintaining a public image of collaboration with the Yuuzhan Vong, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and his [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] attempted to funnel [[Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] on the invaders to the governing [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Employing a [[Unidentified pilot (Birgis)|pilot]] at Birgis to deliver the information, Fett hoped that the New Republic would be able to evacuate the site of a future Yuuzhan Vong conquest<ref name="BFPM" />&mdash;the Outer Rim world<ref name="Atlas" /> of [[New Holgha]], which would be attacked in three [[Standard month/Legends|months]]' [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="BFPM" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|How long does it take to evacuate a planet, anyway? Where do you put displaced worlds at a few weeks' notice?"<br />"I don't need you to make me feel better about it."<br />"Just saying it wouldn't have made much difference numerically even if the New Republic ''had'' believed the intel we gave them. Millions were still going to die either way.|Goran Beviin and Boba Fett on New Holgha|<ref name="BFPM" />}}
The New Republic, however, believed that the Mandalorians had fed them misinformation, and relocated New Holgha's garrison to the Republic stronghold at<ref name="BFPM" /> the astronomical object<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;Based on corresponding data for [[Pedd system/Legends|Pedd system]]</ref> [[Pedd Four]], believing it to be the Yuuzhan Vong's actual goal. Left without any considerable defensive capability, and with its long-range defensive satellite sabotaged overnight, New Holgha fell without much resistance<ref name="BFPM" /> to Yuuzhan Vong forces fresh from the [[Attack on the Vinsoth system|conquest]] of the nearby [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth system]].<ref name="Atlas" />

The Yuuzhan Vong assailed the planet's [[Five Holy Cities]] with [[Yaret-Kor|magma weapons]] and took the opportunity to refuel one of their living [[miid ro'ik]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] by using a [[Qworlth skaal|dread weapon]] to scavenge raw materials from the planet's surface. Fett, watching the vessel consume [[Tree/Legends|trees]], buildings, and [[New Holghan]] people, was uncomfortably reminded of his experiences inside a [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] creature<ref name="BFPM" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]];<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> he was dispelled from his unease, however, by a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] transmission from the Yuuzhan Vong [[subaltern]] [[Bur'lorr]]. The subaltern had encountered and briefy combated a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and tasked Fett and his fellow Mandalorians to run him down and capture him.<ref name="BFPM" />

Fett and the Protectors trailed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] through the main marketplace of the Five Holy [[City/Legends|Cities]] and cornered him in an alleyway. Spotting the chance to convey intelligence to the New Republic through a more reliable channel, Fett passed more information to the Jedi Knight, who identified himself as [[Kubariet]], and assigned his comrade [[Tiroc Vhon]] to escort Kubariet to safety. Bur'lorr arrived; demanding the location of his quarry, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Mandalorian [[Goran Beviin]]. The Yuuzhan Vong's dying shouts were quelled by nearby [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] fire and so did not alert any other Yuuzhan Vong in the area, but the Mandalorians' victory over the warrior was not without bloodshed; Protector [[Briika Jeban]] was injured by the claws of Bur'lorr's [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|living armor]], and died.<ref name="BFPM" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Every time we meet the New Republic, we'll remind them we fight for the Vong. It has to be that way for this game to work."<br />"But you're fighting two wars at once. Fighting for the New Republic and defending yourselves against us, too."<br />"We'll manage okay.|Boba Fett and Kubariet on Vorpa'ya|<ref name="BFPM" />}}
The loss of Jeban meant that her daughter, [[Dinua Jeban|Dinua]], needed a new [[Parent/Legends|parent]], and so Beviin adopted her.<ref name="BFPM" /> After taking New Holgha as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|empire]], the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of the Shaum Hii system|attacked]] the [[Shaum Hii system/Legends|Shaum Hii system]]. The [[Pedd system/Legends|Pedd system]] had also fallen to the Yuuzhan Vong by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="Atlas" />

Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the New Holgha campaign, Kubariet tracked Fett down to the world of [[Vorpa'ya]] in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] and arranged to keep the public image of the Mandalorian collaboration with the Yuuzhan Vong intact while the Mandalorians continued to ferry vital intelligence to the New Republic.<ref name="BFPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of New Holgha first appeared in [[Karen Traviss]]' [[2006]] [[eBook]] ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''.<ref name="BFPM" />
